protocol: MetalCytoToxDB Ru subset; FIXED Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (BLK-PA12: ScaffoldSplitter desalt-aware _scaffold_for); seeds vary model init only; 30 epochs; batch 128; lr 0.001; n_rows 19135; n_test 215; the ONLY difference between arms is init: tmqm|random

paired_delta.ci_method: percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples, seed 0 (paired per-seed deltas); t-based interval also recorded

gate.why: the paired delta is NEGATIVE (-0.0094) and its t-based 95% CI [-0.0406, +0.0218] includes 0; on the fixed scaffold split tmQM pretraining shows no effect on Ru

honest_negative.statement: On the fixed Bemis-Murcko scaffold split, tmQM-pretrained init does NOT improve Ru test AUC over random init (0.7778 vs 0.7872; paired delta -0.0094, t-based 95% CI [-0.0406, +0.0218], t(4)=-0.84). The previously recorded +0.0181 (CI [+0.0035, +0.0328]) was measured on the degenerate splitter and is not reproducible under a genuine scaffold split.
honest_negative.fallback_invoked: BLK-PA12 honest_negative_fallback: '若重跑后 tmQM A/B 的配对 delta 变得不显著，如实报告为随机切分下的 +0.0181 不稳健'. Here it is not merely non-significant -- the point estimate flipped sign.
honest_negative.what_survives: The paired design still cancels seed variance; the arms remain identical apart from init; both arms loaded the tmQM encoder tensors (so the ON arm was not a silent random arm).

supersedes.previous_protocol: MetalCytoToxDB Ru subset; scaffold split (deterministic, largest_first); seeds vary model init only; 30 epochs; batch 128; lr 1e-3; hidden 128 depth 3; n_rows 19135; n_test 714; the ONLY difference between arms is init: tmqm|random

previous_gate.why: all 5 seeds positive and the 95% CI excludes 0

supersedes.why: the previous run (n_test 714) was on the degenerate scaffold splitter -- molecule-level, not scaffold-disjoint (BLK-PA12). The fixed splitter gives n_test 215 and a different (null) result.
supersedes.cited_by: paper_a/sections/04_results.tex tab:pretrain (Claim 2) -- updated 2026-10-12 to the honest negative

comparator.note: both arms sit below the named 0.81 comparator; the gate is the delta, not the absolute
